## Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New Feature / Agent Node (`feat`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix / Defect Remediation (`fix`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation Update (`docs`)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests Added / Updated (`test`)
- [ ] 🔨 Code Refactoring (`refactor`)
- [ ] ⚙️ CI/CD / Configuration (`chore`)

## Engineering Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the repository's PEP 8 / ESLint style guidelines.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added corresponding unit tests verifying this fix/feature.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally.
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or environment variables are present in code.
- [ ] Updated corresponding documentation in `README.md` or `FRONTEND_API_README.md`.
